credibility.line: Margin promises missed as EBIT margin dropped from 25.3% in Mar 2026 to 24.0% in Sep 2026.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Management promised margin improvement from Q1 FY27, but Q2 FY27 EBIT margin remained stagnant at 24.0%.
Management reported annualized AI revenue reaching $3.1 billion while Sep 2026 revenue grew 11.2% YoY to ₹73,188 crore.
Operating cash flow conversion remains strong at 1.05x PAT in FY26, supporting management's cash generation story.

bull: 5-year operating cash conversion is strong at 101% of PAT, reaching ₹52,094 crore in FY26.
Sep 2026 revenue grew 11.2% YoY to ₹73,188 crore with annualized AI revenue reaching $3.1 billion.
Balance sheet shows high ROCE of 63.0%, ROE of 51.8%, and low D/E ratio of 0.10.
bear: EBIT margin declined 130 bps from 25.3% in Mar 2026 to 24.0% in Sep 2026.
Management promised sequential margin improvement post Q1 FY27, but EBIT margin stayed flat at 24.0%.
Total borrowings increased from ₹7,688 crore in Mar 2023 to ₹11,808 crore in Sep 2026.
watch: EBIT margin progression toward 25% target in coming quarters.
Impact of subcontracting costs on operating margins.
Conversion of $9.6 billion Q2 TCV into revenue.
